user.title: Add iCalendar feed
user.description: Create one secure iCalendar URL for multiple calendars. Include exports only the selected calendars. Exclude exports all calendars except those selected; leave the list empty to export all calendars.

data.timed_alarm_minutes: Default alarm for timed events (minutes before)
data.all_day_alarm_days_before: Default alarm for all-day events (days before)

data_description.feed_name: Name shown for this calendar feed in apps like Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. Leave empty to use the default name.
data_description.filter_mode: Optionally filter exported events using a Python regular expression.
data_description.filter_regex: Regular expression matched against the selected event fields (e.g. ^(?!Private:).* or School|Soccer).
data_description.filter_fields: Which event fields the regex pattern is tested against.
data_description.filter_case_sensitive: When disabled, regex matching ignores letter case.
data_description.event_type_filter: Restrict the feed to timed events only or all-day events only.
data_description.strip_description: Omit event descriptions from the exported feed to avoid leaking private notes or meeting links.
data_description.strip_location: Omit event locations (and skip address lookup) from the exported feed.
data_description.prefix_calendar_name: Prepend [Calendar Name] to each event summary, useful for combined feeds.
data_description.geocoding_url: Nominatim-compatible search endpoint. Sends event locations to this provider for Apple Calendar maps. Leave empty to disable. See the documentation for provider requirements.
data_description.history_weeks: How far back to include past events, in weeks (e.g. 4 for a month, 52 for a year). Set to 0 to exclude past events.
data_description.future_weeks: How far ahead to include upcoming events, in weeks (e.g. 4 for a month, 52 for a year).
data_description.refresh_interval: Suggested polling interval (REFRESH-INTERVAL / X-PUBLISHED-TTL) in minutes. Set to 0 to omit the header.
data_description.timed_alarm_minutes: Add a default VALARM reminder before timed events (0 = at event start, -1 = disabled).
data_description.all_day_alarm_days_before: Add a default VALARM reminder for all-day events this many days before (0 = on the event day, -1 = disabled).
data_description.all_day_alarm_time: Time of day (24-hour HH:MM) when the all-day event alarm fires.
